nodes.speaker: berry_punch
nodes.text: Buy berries and fruits, fresh, sweet, straight from the garden!

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Why buy it if it grows for free right here on the ground?

nodes.speaker: berry_punch
nodes.text: It's obvious. My fruits are of the highest quality, grown with love. And this kind of plant collects dust from the roads and is not tasty at all.

nodes.speaker: berry_punch
nodes.text: Besides, you won't find real oranges anywhere else except at my place.

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Do you also grow berries with "love in the garden"?
